dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おかえり……」
dialogues.en: "Hey you......"
dialogues.text: "Hey you......"

dialogues.jp:
テーブルに向かったまま音夢が気のない返事を
返す。
dialogues.en:
Nemu answered while sounding out of place as she was still
sitting at the table.
dialogues.text:
Nemu answered while sounding out of place as she was still
sitting at the table.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 具合でも悪いのか？
dialogues.en: You don't feel well?
dialogues.text: You don't feel well?

dialogues.jp: そう思い、音夢に近づく。
dialogues.en: I went closer to Nemu as I wondered.
dialogues.text: I went closer to Nemu as I wondered.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うーん……今月も赤字かぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Shoot...... We're in the red again this month......"
dialogues.text: "Shoot...... We're in the red again this month......"

dialogues.jp:
うしろから覗くと、難しい顔をして家計簿とに
らめっこをしていた。
dialogues.en:
I looked from behind and she was looking at the budget book
with a serious face.
dialogues.text:
I looked from behind and she was looking at the budget book
with a serious face.

dialogues.jp: 「まめだな……」
dialogues.en: "You're so organized......"
dialogues.text: "You're so organized......"

dialogues.jp:
別にそんなもんつけなくても、財布の中にどれ
ぐらい残っているか、だいたい分かると思うが。
dialogues.en:
I think you should know how much you have in your wallet
without using the budget book.
dialogues.text:
I think you should know how much you have in your wallet
without using the budget book.

dialogues.jp:
「管理しなきゃならないほど、うちには金はな
　いんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't know we had enough money to even worry about
managing it."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't know we had enough money to even worry about
managing it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お金のあるなしに関わらず、つけるものなん
　です」
dialogues.en: "It isn't a matter of whether you have money or not."
dialogues.text: "It isn't a matter of whether you have money or not."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、また家計簿とにらめっこする。
dialogues.en: Then she turns back to the budget book.
dialogues.text: Then she turns back to the budget book.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……もう少し、節約しないとだめか
　なぁ……。お父さんたちにも悪いし」
dialogues.en:
"Mm... We should cut back a little more. I feel bad for mom
& dad."
dialogues.text:
"Mm... We should cut back a little more. I feel bad for mom
& dad."

dialogues.jp:
冷蔵庫から牛乳を取り出す俺の耳に音夢の呟き
が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: I heard her mumble as I took milk out of the refrigerator.
dialogues.text: I heard her mumble as I took milk out of the refrigerator.

dialogues.jp:
「別に気にする必要はないだろう。必要経費な
　んだし」
dialogues.en: "You shouldn't bother with that. It's a necessary expense."
dialogues.text: "You shouldn't bother with that. It's a necessary expense."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだけど……」
ソファーに座り、コップに口をつける。
dialogues.en:
I sat down at the sofa and started to drink the glass of
milk.
dialogues.text:
I sat down at the sofa and started to drink the glass of
milk.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり無駄遣いは控えないと……」
dialogues.en: "But we should watch how we spend our money......"
dialogues.text: "But we should watch how we spend our money......"

dialogues.jp: そう言いながら、音夢の目が俺をとらえる。
dialogues.en: She looks at me as she says so.
dialogues.text: She looks at me as she says so.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ兄さん。お小遣い減らしていい？」
dialogues.en: "Can I cut back on your spending money?"
dialogues.text: "Can I cut back on your spending money?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ぶほっ……」
dialogues.en: "Cough!"
dialogues.text: "Cough!"

dialogues.jp: 危うく、牛乳を噴出しそうになる。
dialogues.en: I nearly spat the milk out of my mouth.
dialogues.text: I nearly spat the milk out of my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「ダメだ。絶対ダメ。俺が生きていけなくなる」
dialogues.en: "No. Definitely no. How can I survive?"
dialogues.text: "No. Definitely no. How can I survive?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫。食費の分まで減らしたりしないから」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, I won't cut back on the grocery expense."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, I won't cut back on the grocery expense."

dialogues.jp: そういう問題じゃない！
dialogues.en: It's not about that!
dialogues.text: It's not about that!

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Okay? Okay? Okay?"
dialogues.text: "Okay? Okay? Okay?"

dialogues.jp:
万人を操れる音夢の笑顔だが、今ばかりは“Ｎ
Ｏ”と言える日本人にならなければならない。
dialogues.en:
She has a radiant smile which can convince anyone with
anything, but I have to be strong and firm enough to say NO.
dialogues.text:
She has a radiant smile which can convince anyone with
anything, but I have to be strong and firm enough to say NO.

dialogues.jp: 「ダメったらダメだ」
dialogues.en: "I said no."
dialogues.text: "I said no."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「むぅ〜」
dialogues.en: "Booo."
dialogues.text: "Booo."

dialogues.jp: ふてくされた声をだして、頬を膨らませる。
dialogues.en: She puffed her cheeks and booed at me.
dialogues.text: She puffed her cheeks and booed at me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……やっぱ自炊をするしかないのか
　なぁ」
dialogues.en: "Then... do we have to cook ourselves?"
dialogues.text: "Then... do we have to cook ourselves?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の呟きに俺の時間がとまる。
dialogues.en: Her mumble made time freeze.
dialogues.text: Her mumble made time freeze.

dialogues.jp: （ちょっと待て。それだけは勘弁してくれ）
dialogues.en: (Hold on. Let's not go there.)
dialogues.text: (Hold on. Let's not go there.)

dialogues.jp: 死人がでる。
dialogues.en: Somebody will die.
dialogues.text: Somebody will die.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……ホント、どうしよう……」
dialogues.en: "Sigh...... I don't know what else to do......"
dialogues.text: "Sigh...... I don't know what else to do......"

dialogues.jp: 俺は問題が先送りされることを切に願った……。
dialogues.en:
I really wished that she'd forget about this for a
while......
dialogues.text:
I really wished that she'd forget about this for a
while......

dialogues.jp: ◆家計簿◆
dialogues.en: ◆The family budget book◆
dialogues.text: ◆The family budget book◆

dialogues.jp:
家計簿と睨めっこの音夢が、俺の小遣いを減ら
してもいいかと｛き／訊｝いてきた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu asked me if she can cut back on my spending money as
she looked at the budget book.
dialogues.text:
Nemu asked me if she can cut back on my spending money as
she looked at the budget book.

dialogues.jp:
万人を操る東洋の微笑みに耐え、俺はそれを却
下する。
dialogues.en: I resisted her radiant smile and denied the request.
dialogues.text: I resisted her radiant smile and denied the request.

dialogues.jp:
しかし今度は自炊を検討しだす音夢に、俺は問
題が先送りされることを切に願うのだった……。
dialogues.en:
But then, she was thinking about cooking at home, and I
really wished that she'd forget about this for a while.
dialogues.text:
But then, she was thinking about cooking at home, and I
really wished that she'd forget about this for a while.
